BEFORE THE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
                   OF THE STATE OF MISSOURI
   In the Matter of Union Electric Company           )
   d/b/a Ameren Missouri’s Tariff to Adjust its      )   Case No. ER-2026-0291
   Revenues for Electric Service                     )

                               ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE

Issue Date: November 10, 2026                            Effective Date: November 10, 2026

        On July 15, 2026, Missouri Industrial Energy Consumers (MIEC) filed an application

to intervene. No party objected, and the Commission granted the application on July 30,

2026.

        On August 13, 2026, in an entirely separate case, Case No. WR-2026-0304, the

Commission found MIEC’s application to intervene deficient because MIEC was an

unincorporated association, and Commission Rule 20 CSR 4240-2.075(2)(D) requires

unincorporated associations to list all of its members before being granted intervention. An

amended application to intervene was filed on that case by two parties stating they were

both separate and distinct members of MIEC, as a result of the Commission’s finding, on

August 20, 2026.

        Similar to Case No. WR-2026-0304, the Commission will order MIEC to show cause

as to why MIEC should not be dismissed as a party to this case and its individual members

be required to intervene individually.

        THE COMMISSION ORDERS THAT:

        1.    MIEC shall respond as ordered above no later than November 20, 2026.

        2.    This order is effective when issued.
                                                  BY THE COMMISSION




                                                 Nancy Dippell
                                                 Secretary

Ronald D. Pridgin, Deputy Chief Regulatory
